components.marketing_pages: Custom HTML/Tailwind to allow extreme layout flexibility and bento grids.

hero_background.description: 3D render of a futuristic global supercomputer network, glowing golden nodes across a dark obsidian world. Use as full-screen hero background.

data_stream_abstract.description: Abstract data stream visualization with glowing gold data lines. Use for Dashboard background elements or Admin Command Center.

geometric_accent.description: Minimalist glowing gold geometric shape. Use for feature section illustrations or marketing graphics.

texture_background.description: Close up of a black and gold abstract texture. Great for section dividers or footer background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic tailwind grays for backgrounds; use the specified #0A0A0A and #121212.
Implement a massive, pulsing 'Grid Connection' start button in the user dashboard that toggles connection state.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for all primary headings (H1, H2, H3). Use Unbounded for large numbers like the PetaFLOPS counter and Earnings.
Ensure all cards in the dashboard utilize the 'card_glass' class styles with internal p-6 or p-8 padding.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, links, forms, toggles).
For the Admin Command Center Global War Map, use glowing dots (absolute positioning or a canvas library) on top of the 'data_stream_abstract' image.
Withdraw Now button should have a disabled state (dimmed, gray) until the $5 threshold is reached, then apply the 'glow_accent' and 'button_primary' styling.
Do not use the standard Shadcn UI aesthetic. Apply the custom borders, gold hover states, and dark mode background colors.
